observations.message: Automatic episode diagnosis separates explicit recorded stop mechanisms from unproven physical/upstream causes and goal-selection hypotheses.
Consecutive navigation decision events measure every zero-request HOLD, merging reason changes and retaining short motion intervals; zero long episodes is not a healthy-navigation verdict.
Qualified local-pose samples measure low translational progress even while turning. These sampled estimates do not prove a physical stall or localization accuracy.
